goal: Make Immune-Brain define Subagent Role contracts while Pi supplies model, provider, and thinking defaults, without weakening Kernel Review reservation and receipt authority.

acceptance.assertion: Kernel Review reservation parameters omit model and thinking policy; receipt matching accepts Host-omitted or Host-reported model and thinking values while continuing to reject any changed reserved authority field or unknown extra Agent argument.

Kernel Review still reserves one foreground isolated Agent invocation with exact role description, immutable prompt, inherit-context policy, filesystem isolation, workload-derived max_turns, prohibited resume and schedule, matching tool-call identity, terminal result ordering, snapshot revalidation, and fail-closed settlement.

Canonical and packaged Subagent dispatch contracts state that Immune-Brain owns Role, evidence, authority, tool policy, and output contracts; Pi owns model, provider, and thinking defaults; exact Review receipt matching applies only to reserved authority parameters; and no Immune-Brain model tier, provider map, cost router, or fallback is introduced.
